purpose: Use Google Alerts email as a low-cost discovery feed for dated industry intelligence without treating email snippets as verified facts.

source.query: from:googlealerts-noreply@google.com ("smart glasses" OR "AR glasses" OR "AI glasses")

gates.discovery_is_not_evidence: Google Alerts and email snippets locate possible sources but never substantiate a product, market or government claim.
gates.article_rights: Do not retain full copyrighted article text. Fetch and quote only within the applicable source policy and copyright limits.
gates.credibility: Consequential claims require primary evidence or corroboration from genuinely independent sources.
gates.privacy: Store no unrelated email, contact graph, attachments or message body.
gates.content: Never represent scraped reporting as original reporting or firsthand experience.
gates.promotion: A news discovery item cannot become an industry event or video claim until the original source passes admission, credibility, rights and freshness checks.
gates.publication: Every exact post, blog article, video and metadata package remains human-approved before publication.

cost.note: Gmail discovery is expected to remain within Google's standard no-charge quota for this scale. Article research and model work need separate bounded admission.

resilience.email_is_one_adapter: Google Alerts is a useful discovery adapter, not a single point of truth or availability.
resilience.fallback_design: Approved direct sources, lawful feeds and bounded web research may create the same news discovery contract after their own access and rights gates.
resilience.no_delivery_behavior: Record a diagnostic state and continue unrelated work; do not fabricate events or loosen the Gmail query to unrelated personal mail.
